items.source: The value() is optional and represents an order value as defined in the Ordered interface. Lower values have higher priority. The default value is Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE, indicating the lowest priority (losing to any other specified order value).
items.translation: `value()` 是可选的，表示在Ordered接口中定义的订单值。数值越低优先级越高。默认值为Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE，表示最低优先级（低于任何其他指定的订单值）。

items.source: Since Spring 4.1, the standard Priority annotation can be used as a drop-in replacement for this annotation in ordering scenarios. Note that @Priority may have additional semantics when a single element has to be picked (see AnnotationAwareOrderComparator.getPriority(Object)).
items.translation: 自 Spring 4.1 起，标准的 `Priority` 注解可作为此注解在排序场景中的直接替代品。请注意，当需要选取单个元素时，`@Priority` 可能具有额外的语义（参见 AnnotationAwareOrderComparator.getPriority(Object)）。

items.source: NOTE: Since Spring 4.0, annotation-based ordering is supported for many kinds of components in Spring, even for collection injection where the order values of the target components are taken into account (either from their target class or from their @Bean method). While such order values may influence priorities at injection points, please be aware that they do not influence singleton startup order which is an orthogonal concern determined by dependency relationships and @DependsOn declarations (influencing a runtime-determined dependency graph).
items.translation: 注意：自 Spring 4.0 起，Spring 支持多种组件的基于注解的排序，包括集合注入（此时会考虑目标组件的顺序值，这些值来自其目标类或其 @Bean 方法）。虽然此类顺序值可能会影响注入点的优先级，但请注意，它们不会影响单例启动顺序；后者是一个正交的关注点，由依赖关系和 @DependsOn 声明决定（从而影响运行时确定的依赖图）。

items.source: Alternatively, order values may also be determined on a per-instance basis through the Ordered interface, allowing for configuration-determined instance values instead of hard-coded values attached to a particular class.
items.translation: 或者，也可以通过Ordered接口按实例确定顺序值，从而允许使用配置确定的实例值，而不是将硬编码的值附加到特定类。

items.source: Consult the javadoc for OrderComparator for details on the sort semantics for non-ordered objects.
items.translation: 有关非有序对象的排序语义的详细信息，请参阅OrderComparator的javadoc。
